adaptations: Package-relative imports and caller-supplied asset paths replace workspace-dependent execution.
Predictor reproduction mode retains corpus admissibility, source-kind, masking and split checks without requiring an internal approval record.
Retrieval evaluation accepts explicit frozen membership, including the manuscript 65-question subset; calibration remains 25+25 and is frozen before EVAL outcomes are read.
Training schedulers and remote launch services are not part of the distribution; run commands use explicit devices and time caps.
Matched forecast solver aliases are normalized without changing embedding indices; numerical model and loss definitions are retained.
Publication includes code, configurations and synthetic checks. Per-question data, results reports and internal execution records are excluded.
